promise: Dec 7, 2017: final Basel III reforms ('Basel IV') would be implemented 'as of 1 January 2022'
description: Delayed to Jan 1, 2023 (Mar 2020, COVID), then Jan 1, 2025; the US still has not implemented as of end-2025 (July 2023 proposal targeted 2027-28; scaled back and redrafted in Dec 2025)
sources: BIS Governors and Heads of Supervision statement, Mar 27, 2020, bis.org
